hero.title: Your calendar can look full and still waste your day

simple.subtitle: Same job, same kind of clients, but a very different day. MagicHango helps clients book the slots that actually fit the trainer's route, instead of scattering visits across the city.

before.title: Agenda 1 — Without MagicHango
before.subtitle: 3 sessions, but the day is broken by long drives and lost gaps.
before.footer: The day is not empty, but it is badly assembled. The trainer only bills 3 hours while too much of the day is consumed by travel and wasted time.

idleGap.title: Lost gap
idleGap.meta: Too short or too awkward to insert another session

after.title: Agenda 2 — With MagicHango
after.subtitle: 4 sessions, less waste, and the last client is closer to home.
after.footer: MagicHango does not just fill the calendar. It helps place the right clients in the right time slots, in an order that actually makes sense for the route.

animation.helper: Switch between the two states to watch slots move, shrink, appear, and reorganize into a more logical route.
animation.mapsHint: Click to open in Google Maps
animation.mapsFeatureBody: Travel slots can also become action points. In this demo, clicking a travel slot opens a Google Maps route so the trainer can go straight from schedule to navigation.
animation.beforeReasonOne: At first, Marcus & Blue are too early in the day, so the late morning cannot be used for a client who fits the route better.
animation.beforeReasonTwo: Olivia & Pepper are close to home. Moving them to the afternoon makes room to push Marcus & Blue later and free the 9:00 to 10:00 slot.
animation.beforeReasonThree: After those moves, the route is compact enough to keep a real break and still add one more session.
animation.afterReasonOne: Marcus & Blue are recommended later, which opens space for a closer session before them.
animation.afterReasonTwo: Olivia & Pepper are recommended in the afternoon, closer to home. That helps free the morning for the 9:00 to 10:00 session.
animation.afterReasonThree: The result is simple: one more session, less driving, and an easier return home.
